name: hearing loss-familial salivary gland insensitivity to aldosterone syndrome
description: Hearing loss-familial salivary gland insensitivity to aldosterone syndrome is characterized by bilateral moderate-to-severe sensorineural hearing loss and salivary gland insensitivity to aldosterone resulting in hyponatremia. It has been described in two brothers. Transmission appeared to be autosomal recessive.
